```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var PIECES_KEY = 'pieces:exploring';
  var CB_KEY     = 'checklist:' + window.location.pathname;
  var N          = 4;
  var AOI_OPTS   = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var CTX_OPTS   = ['', 'Personal', 'Local', 'Global'];
  var PRAC_OPTS  = ['None', 'Creating', 'Performing'];
  var INP = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var SEL = INP + 'cursor:pointer;';
  var TH  = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD  = 'padding:.25rem .2rem;';

  function blank() { return { name:'', composer:'', genre:'', aoi:'', context:'', practical:'' }; }
  function loadPieces() {
    try { var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PIECES_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<N)d.push(blank()); return d.slice(0,N); }
    catch(e) { return Array(N).fill(null).map(blank); }
  }
  var pieces = loadPieces();
  function savePieces() { try{localStorage.setItem(PIECES_KEY,JSON.stringify(pieces));}catch(e){} }
  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

  function buildSel(field, opts, val, row) {
    var h = '<select data-row="'+row+'" data-field="'+field+'" style="'+SEL+'">';
    opts.forEach(function(o){ h+='<option value="'+esc(o)+'"'+(val===o?' selected':'')+'>'+(o||'—')+'</option>'; });
    return h+'</select>';
  }

  function renderTracker() {
    var c = document.getElementById('piece-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<'+'table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI','Context','Practical exercise'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<N; r++) {
      h += '<tr>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(pieces[r][f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel('aoi',      AOI_OPTS,  pieces[r].aoi,      r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:7em;">'+buildSel('context',  CTX_OPTS,  pieces[r].context,  r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:9em;">'+buildSel('practical',PRAC_OPTS, pieces[r].practical, r)+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        pieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        savePieces(); runAutoChecks(); saveCheckboxes();
      });
    });
  }

  function setCheck(substr, val) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.task-list li').forEach(function(li){
      if (li.textContent.indexOf(substr) > -1) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (cb) cb.checked = val;
      }
    });
  }

  function runAutoChecks() {
    var aois  = pieces.map(function(p){return p.aoi;}).filter(Boolean);
    var ctxs  = pieces.map(function(p){return p.context;}).filter(Boolean);
    var creat = pieces.filter(function(p){return p.practical==='Creating';});
    var perf  = pieces.filter(function(p){return p.practical==='Performing'&&(p.context==='Local'||p.context==='Global');});

    setCheck('two different areas of inquiry', new Set(aois).size >= 2);
    setCheck('three contexts', ctxs.indexOf('Personal')>-1 && ctxs.indexOf('Local')>-1 && ctxs.indexOf('Global')>-1);
    setCheck('Creating exercise stimulus', creat.length >= 1);

    var adaptOk = perf.length >= 1;
    if (adaptOk && creat.length >= 1 && creat[0].aoi && perf[0].aoi) adaptOk = perf[0].aoi !== creat[0].aoi;
    setCheck('Performed adaptation stimulus', adaptOk);
  }

  var boxes;
  function saveCheckboxes() {
    try{localStorage.setItem(CB_KEY,JSON.stringify((boxes||[]).map(function(b){return b.checked;})));}catch(e){}
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    renderTracker();
    boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.task-list input[type="checkbox"]'));
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.removeAttribute('disabled'); cb.style.cursor='pointer'; });
    try {
      var sv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CB_KEY));
      if (Array.isArray(sv)) boxes.forEach(function(cb,i){ if(sv[i]!==undefined)cb.checked=!!sv[i]; });
    } catch(e) {}
    runAutoChecks();
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', saveCheckboxes); });
  });

  window.resetExploringChecklist = function() {
    pieces = Array(N).fill(null).map(blank);
    savePieces(); renderTracker();
    if (boxes) { boxes.forEach(function(b){b.checked=false;}); saveCheckboxes(); runAutoChecks(); saveCheckboxes(); }
  };
})();
</script>
<style>
.task-list input[type="checkbox"] { width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 0.4em; }
</style>
<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
<button onclick="resetExploringChecklist();" style="font-size:0.78rem;padding:0.25rem 0.7rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#888;cursor:pointer;">Reset checklist</button>
</div>
```

---

## Repertoire decisions

<div id="piece-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto;"></div>

- [ ] At least **two different areas of inquiry** are represented across all pieces
- [ ] All **three contexts** are covered: personal, local, and global
- [ ] Creating exercise stimulus is identified (a piece explored in Section 1)
- [ ] Performed adaptation stimulus is identified: **local or global context**, different AOI from creating

---

## Section 1: Exploration of diverse musical material

**For each piece:**

- [ ] Area of inquiry is **stated and justified** — not just named
- [ ] Context (personal/local/global) is justified
- [ ] **Musical findings** are present (from scores/recordings): conventions, devices, techniques
- [ ] Musical findings are located with **bar numbers or exact timestamps** pointing to Upload 3
- [ ] **Extra-musical findings** are present (from articles, interviews, etc.)
- [ ] Extra-musical findings are **relevant** to the music — not anecdotal biography
- [ ] All sources have **in-text citations** — not only a bibliography at the end
- [ ] Analysis explains *why* devices are used 

---

## Section 2: Creating exercise

- [ ] Based on a style **explored in Section 1**
- [ ] Creating exercise audio included in Upload 2 *(max 1 min)*
- [ ] Score or notation **embedded in the document** (max 32 bars or 1 min audio)
- [ ] Notation is appropriate to the style and clearly communicates the exercise
- [ ] Statement explains which **creating conventions** were applied and **where**
- [ ] Statement explains how **Section 1 research directly informed** the exercise

---

## Section 3: Performed adaptation

- [ ] Stimulus (original music) included in Upload 2 *(max 1 min)*
- [ ] Performed adaptation audio included in Upload 2 *(max 2 min)*
- [ ] From a **local or global** context — NOT personal
- [ ] Statement explains which **performing practices** were identified in the original style
- [ ] Statement explains how practices were **adapted for your instrument**
- [ ] Adaptation AOI is confirmed as **different from creating** AOI

---

## Upload 1: Written document

- [ ] Word count is within **2,400 words** (in-text citations and bibliography excluded)
- [ ] Compiled in one pdf in order: **Section 1 → Section 2 → Section 3 → Bibliography**
- [ ] Visual evidence is **embedded in the text**, not appended
- [ ] Visual evidence does not exceed **5 pages**
- [ ] Score for creating exercise is embedded in Section 2
- [ ] Track list and timings included as appendix (not in word count)
- [ ] Bibliography complete and includes all scores, recordings, and secondary sources

---

## Upload 2: Audio evidence

- [ ] Total audio does not exceed **4 minutes**
- [ ] Compiled in order: **Creating exercise → Stimulus → Performed adaptation**
- [ ] Creating exercise audio does not exceed **1 minute**
- [ ] Stimulus does not exceed **1 minute**
- [ ] Performed adaptation does not exceed **2 minutes**
- [ ] Audio quality allows full assessment of the exercises
- [ ] Exact timings are specified in the written document

---

## Upload 3: Audio reference material

- [ ] Total audio does not exceed **3 minutes**
- [ ] Contains only excerpts of **music analysed in Section 1**
- [ ] Compiled in the order excerpts appear in the writing
- [ ] Timestamps in Upload 3 match the references in the written document

---

## Common errors to rule out

- [ ] Timestamps in writing point to **Upload 3** — not to YouTube, Spotify, or original commercial recordings
- [ ] Score excerpts are **annotated** and connected to specific analytical claims — not decorative
- [ ] AOIs are **justified with musical evidence** — not just labelled
- [ ] Creating exercise and performed adaptation are from **two different AOIs**
- [ ] Performed adaptation is based on **local or global** music — not personal
- [ ] Creating exercise and adaptation are both referenced **back to Section 1 research**
- [ ] Word count checked with citations removed
